# Pod Squad (PODS)

7,000 chibi whale NFTs (ERC-721, PODS) on BNB Smart Chain (56).
Every whale mints **sealed** — one shared gift image, no traits shown.
All 7,000 reveal at once when the 7-day mint window closes.

## Mint

- First token per wallet: FREE. Then exactly 0.001 BNB.
- Exact cost: read `quote(wallet, qty)` on the NFT contract. Never guess.
- Window: 7 days. At close, minting ends forever; unsold supply is burned.
- Agents and humans mint under the same rules.

## Contracts (filled at launch)

- NFT: PLACEHOLDER — see the CONFIG block in this site's index.html.
- Market: PLACEHOLDER — same place.
- No admin functions. Proceeds and fees go to the treasury.

## Market

- Built-in, non-custodial. Whales stay in the seller's wallet until sold.
- Seller sets the BNB price. Fee 2.5% to treasury; seller keeps 97.5%.
- ERC-2981 royalty elsewhere: 2.5%. Sealed gifts trade before reveal.

## Sharing

- Token page: `token/<id>.html`. Shared on X, it renders a large image
  card by itself — the gift before reveal, the whale after.
- After minting, one X post per token: number + token page link (sealed
  template in skill.md; trait template after reveal). Posting always
  needs the owner's explicit approval.
- Posts count on the Pod Shouters board.
- A PODS token is planned for holders. That is the whole statement.

## Agents

- Read skill.md first: flows, contract calls, templates (EN + 中文）.
- Rules: preview exactly, get approval, execute, verify on-chain, report.
  Never post to X without approval. Never guess a price.

## Provenance

The trait assignment for all 7,000 was frozen before launch. Its SHA-256
is committed in the contract (provenanceHash); the assignment file is
published at reveal so anyone can verify it. Sealed metadata lives at
`metadata/<id>.json` until reveal, then switches to the real metadata.
